scoring_justification: We recompute structural and aggregate metrics from the agent's submitted CSV tables (alpha vs T, gamma_C vs freq) to verify the physical behaviour reported in the paper: negativity below 60 K, minimum near 40 K, zero crossing around 60 K, negative integrated gamma_C in the 0–100 cm⁻¹ region, and shape of the frequency dependence. The total gamma_CV is compared to a hidden paper-derived value.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference alpha_vs_T curve, binned gamma_C sign/min characteristics, and total gamma_CV gold value
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Fig.11b (ice Ih, 0.1 MPa, TIP4P/2005, quasiharmonic) and Fig.13a; total integrated gamma_CV inferred from Fig.13a area
hidden_assets.generation_method: digitised/estimated from the published figures and encoded in the reference solve.sh as the oracle answer
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values match the qualitative and quantitative description in the paper: negative alpha below 60 K, minimum ~40 K, negative gamma_C in 0–100 cm⁻¹, and a total around -0.04 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹.

outputs.description: Thermal expansivity α(T) for ice Ih at 0.1 MPa, with T from 0 to 100 K in 5 K steps.
Frequency‑binned (10 cm⁻¹ bins, 0–200 cm⁻¹) average γ_j C_j at T=30 K for ice Ih.
Total γ C_V at T=30 K for ice Ih (single row).

output_contract.notes: All outputs must be computed using the TIP4P/2005 water model within the quasiharmonic approximation, without fitting to the paper's reported values.
